turns.text: Deal. Don't forget your student card, the desk asks for it!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Are we still doing the BBQ on Sunday? Weather says rain from midday

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The forecast changes every hour. Let's check again tonight

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I checked three apps, they all say something different. Lol

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Then we set up the gazebo just in case. Who's bringing the chairs?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Tom has six, we need at least eight

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Okay, I'll ask Sarah. Are the burgers vegan-friendly for Jen?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I got the veggie ones, plus halloumi for the rest of us

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yum. Did you get charcoal or gas? The gas was empty last time

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Charcoal, but it takes forever to heat up. Start early

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Do you think we can do it at 4pm if it stays dry?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Maybe, let's text everyone at 2pm and decide then

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Fine. Fingers crossed for sun!! ;)

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: My in-laws are coming for dinner on Friday. Any ideas that won't be a disaster?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Roast chicken is hard to mess up. Do they eat meat?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, but Gerald doesn't like skin. Weird I know

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Then chicken thighs, skinless. Serve with roast potatoes and green beans

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is that too boring? I want to impress them a bit

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Make a dessert then. Sticky toffee pudding always works

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I've never made that. How long does it take?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: About an hour, but you can make the sauce the day before

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ok good. Can I borrow your big roasting tin?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sure, it's in the cupboard above the sink. Wash it first though lol

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Haha yes. Thanks for the help, you're a lifesaver

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No problem. Take photos, I want to see the pudding!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The wifi keeps dropping every 20 minutes. Driving me nuts

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Have you tried restarting the router?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Twice. The light goes orange and then red

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Could be the line or the router itself. Do you have a cable spare?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yeah, I'll plug the laptop straight into the router. Let's see if it works

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: And if the internet is fine on cable, it's the wifi signal

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ok, cable works for now. Still weird. The provider website says no outages

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Call them and ask for a line check. Do it on speaker

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: They'll put me on hold for 40 minutes, I know

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Put the kettle on first then ;) Seriously though, get them to send an engineer

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ugh. Fine. Calling after lunch

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Let me know what they say. I can't survive without my Netflix either

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thinking about doing Vienna by train in August. Are you in?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: How many days? I can't get more than five off

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Four would be enough. Route via Munich, overnight train from there

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Overnight sounds cheap but I hate sleeping sitting up

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: There are couchettes, the bunk beds in shared cabins. I'll look at the prices

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ok that's a fair option. How much extra for a couchette?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Around 30 to 40 euros each, I think

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Fine by me. Do we book the hostel now or later?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Now, the good ones fill up fast in summer

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ok, send me the link. I'll check my holiday days at work tomorrow

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Will do. Vienna has amazing coffee houses btw, we have to go to one

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes! Just no more five hour queues like last time, deal?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Deal. Bring a power bank, the trains are full of phones on charge

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Did you reply to Lily's wedding invite? The deadline is this Friday

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Not yet, I didn't know if I'd be able to take the Saturday off

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It's on the 14th of June in Brighton, so a long weekend would work

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: True. Do I need to bring a plus one? The card says Name and guest

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I think they meant that, yes. Is your partner coming?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, Hannah wants to come. She already said she'd sit with the kids table, lol

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ha. So I'll put two places down then

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Do you know what the dress code is? Smart casual?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Lily said cocktail, so nice dress or suit. Not white obviously

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Obviously. I'm wearing the navy one from Dad's birthday

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good choice. Email the RSVP tonight so you don't forget!!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Could you walk Biscuit on Wednesday? I've got back to back meetings until 6

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Of course! What time works?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Around noon and then again at five. He needs his lunch walk properly

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Does he still pull on the lead near other dogs?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Only if they come too close. Go past the big park, it's quieter

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ok, got it. Does he get fed at lunch?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Half a tin, it's in the fridge. Not the whole thing, he gets fat

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Noted. Anything else I should know?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: He steals socks from the laundry basket, so keep the door shut

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Haha my cat does the same thing. Brings them to my bed like a present

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's sweet. Thanks, I owe you a pint! I'll send pics

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes please, only the good ones though ;)

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I've lost my house keys. Probably on the bus this morning

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oh no. Did you check the lost property office?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Called them, nothing handed in. Typical

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Where's the spare set?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: With my mum in Leeds, she's away until Sunday

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: You can crash at mine tonight, the sofa bed is free

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You're a star. Do you think the locksmith will charge a fortune?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Probably around 150 quid, it's an emergency call-out

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'll ring the landlord first, he might have a spare

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Good idea. Also get the lock changed if the keys were stolen

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Honestly I think I just dropped them. Anyway, sorry for the drama

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No drama. Come round at 6, I'll make pasta

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The car needs an MOT by the end of the month. Do you think it'll pass?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: How many miles on it now?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: About 98000. The brakes were a bit squeaky last year

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Get the garage to check them first, otherwise you're failing for sure

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: They quoted 60 pounds for the check, which seems fair

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: And the headlight? Left one looked dim when we drove home

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, I forgot about that. A new bulb is only a few quid

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Get it done before the test, cheap way to avoid a fail

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Appointment is the 28th at 8:15am. I'm in the office by nine

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I can drive you there if you want, I'm free that morning

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You're the best. Can you bring the car back to mine after?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, but then you owe me a fry-up at the cafe. Deal?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Deal. Make it two sausages please ;)

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Fancy a hike in the Lake District in October? I've been wanting to do Helvellyn

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Helvellyn is a serious climb, are you sure? Which route?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: From Glenridding, up Swirral Edge, about 12 km

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's doable. How many metres of ascent?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Around 950, I think. Steep at the end

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ok, I'm in. But we pack waterproofs, the forecast is grim

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The forecast is always grim up there lol

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yeah but I don't want a repeat of last time, we were soaked for hours

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Fair. Trekking poles too? My knees are not what they were

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, get the poles, I'll bring the flask and sandwiches

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Train or car? Parking in Glenridding is a nightmare

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Train to Penrith, then a bus. Earlier start is better, 7am?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: 7am it is. Bring the good boots this time ;)

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I need to cancel my gym membership. Any idea how?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Do they need a letter or can you do it online?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The contract says written notice, 30 days before the end of the month

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's annoying. How much is it?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: 35 pounds a month, and I haven't been in three months

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Then send it today, otherwise they'll auto renew

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I found a template online, just need to add my member number

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Put the date and your address on it too. Keep a copy

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Sure, will do. Do I need to sign anything else?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Just the letter. Send it recorded delivery so you have proof

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good call. Are you coming to spin tonight? ;)

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Nope, you just cancelled your membership, go and have a nap

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I have a job interview on Monday at a logistics company. I'm so nervous

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: You'll be fine! What are they asking?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Strengths, weaknesses and why I want to work there

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Weakness is always the trap question. Have you got an answer?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'll say I sometimes take on too much. Is that okay?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Works, but add how you deal with it now. Show you've learned from it

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good point. The interview is at 10, I'm worried about the train

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Leave an hour early, the rail replacement buses are a joke right now

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ugh. I'll take the car then. Where do I park?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Check their site, they probably have a car park for visitors

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ok. Should I wear a suit or is smart casual fine?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Suit, even if they're relaxed. First impressions matter

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ok, thanks. Text me when it's over!!

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Of course, you've got this!!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Got two tickets for the 8:15 showing tonight, I'm running late though

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oh nice. Which film?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The animated one with the raccoon. It's not deep but it's funny

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Perfect. I'll be at the entrance at 7:45, we can grab popcorn

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Popcorn is 9 pounds now, that's criminal

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Lol we'll share a small one then. Who's paying for the tickets?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'll pay, you get the popcorn. Deal?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Deal. Row F or in the middle?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Row F is free, seats 11 and 12. Good spot

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Great. See you there, and don't be late again!!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm literally running right now, the bus is taking forever

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The restaurant lost our booking for tonight. We're standing outside in the rain

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Are you serious? Ask them to check under my surname

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Already did, they say they have us down for tomorrow

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's not right, I confirmed it on Tuesday. Show them the email

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Showing them now. The manager is looking at the screen

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ok, any luck? We're 15 minutes away

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: They found a table but it's the cramped one near the toilets lol

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Better than standing outside. Ask for a drink on the house

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The waiter already offered free garlic bread. Not bad

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Haha ok, that's some compensation. See you soon, keep the seat warm

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ha yes, hurry up. The bread is going fast!!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Are you up for the Christmas market on Saturday? Mulled wine is calling

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes! Which one? The big one in the city centre or the small one by the church?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The small one, it's cosier and less crowded

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Good call. What time, afternoon or evening?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Four o'clock, we can see the lights come on at dark

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Perfect. Do you want to get dinner after?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Maybe sausages at the stall by the fountain. Those were amazing last year

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oh yes, with the mustard. I'll be the one smelling of smoke lol

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Haha. Bring gloves, last year my fingers went numb

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I know. I'm bringing two pairs this time

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Smart. Shall we meet at the big clock at 3:50 then?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, I'll be on time for once ;)

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Don't make promises you can't keep!!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is it normal that the couple upstairs rearrange their furniture at 11pm every night?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ugh, no. Quiet hours usually start at 10pm, check your lease

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I did. It says 10pm, so they're definitely breaking it

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Have you talked to them yet? Could be a one-off

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Not yet. I'm not great at confrontation tbh

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Just leave a polite note under their door, that's usually enough

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hmm. Do I sign it or stay anonymous?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sign it, anonymous notes look worse lol

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Fair. I'll write it tonight and slip it under the door in the morning

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Good plan. If it keeps going, the letting agent can help

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thanks, I'll try the note first. Fingers crossed

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Let me know how it goes. I'm around this weekend if you need backup

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ha, you'd make a good wingman. Cheers!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: My fridge has been making a weird humming noise since this morning

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Is it still cold inside?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Kind of, but the milk already feels a bit warm :(

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oh no. Did you try unplugging it and plugging it back in?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, didn't help. The compressor just runs non-stop now

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sounds like the thermostat or the compressor. Is it still under warranty?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No idea, it's about five years old. Probably not

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Check the receipt anyway, some brands offer longer cover

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good shout. Should I put the food on the balcony for now? It's only 4 degrees out

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No way, your ice cream would turn to soup. Use a cool box

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I've got one from the summer barbecue. Thanks mate!

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Anytime. Let me know when the engineer has been

chats.topic: First week at a new job

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Day five at the new job and I already feel like I'm drowning in emails

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oof. Did your manager at least show you around?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Briefly. Then she said 'you'll pick it up' and disappeared into a meeting

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's rough. Who else is on your team?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Two people, both super friendly, but they're flat out too

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ask them to block off half an hour for questions. Works wonders

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good idea. I was too scared to interrupt anyone

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Everyone is at the start, nobody expects you to know everything yet

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ok, that's reassuring. Lunch with Priya tomorrow?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes! Take a proper lunch break, not at your desk this time

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Haha, you're right. Coffee in the park it is

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Great. Tell me the name of that Italian place you mentioned, I'm curious

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Mia has been crying all night, she keeps pulling at her left ear

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oh no, poor thing. Temperature?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: 38.5 at midnight. We gave her Calpol and she slept a bit

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sounds like an ear infection. Are you calling the GP in the morning?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, the surgery opens at 8, I'll be first in line

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Good, don't wait. Ear infections in toddlers can get nasty quickly

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yeah, that's what scares me. Do you still have Lily's old travel pillow?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, it's in the car boot. Why, is she sleeping in the car?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No, the taxi to the surgery. She'd be more comfortable with it

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Makes sense. I'll drop it round, give me twenty minutes

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You're a lifesaver. Text me when you're at the door

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Will do. Keep her warm and give her plenty of fluids

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Are you bringing something to the bake sale on Saturday? We need cakes for the table

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yep, I'm making lemon drizzle. Is that ok?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Perfect! We're aiming for two pounds a slice

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Two pounds is fair for lemon drizzle. Does it need to be nut free?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes please, we had that allergy issue last year

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No problem, my drizzle is nut free anyway. Where do I drop it off?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hall at 8:30, the caterers set up at 9

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sure. Can I borrow the big urn? My coffee machine has died

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Haha, the urn is basically the only thing that works here. Bring a flask too

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Brilliant, I'll bring two flasks then

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thanks love. You're saving the day

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Still no word from the landlord about our deposit, it's been six weeks

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Hmm. Did they send the inventory report?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, they claim the oven needs professional cleaning. Ridiculous

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did you take photos when you moved out?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes! Dozens. They're stored in the cloud

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Perfect. Reply in writing and ask for the deposit back within 14 days

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is that the legal deadline or just a suggestion?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Deposits should be protected in a scheme, so check the deadline on their website

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ok, I'll look it up tonight

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Good. Send the email tonight and attach the photos

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Will do. I'm not paying for a cleaner I never booked

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Stand your ground. You deserve your 900 pounds back

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Brunch on Sunday? That new place by the canal has amazing pancakes

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sounds lovely. What time were you thinking?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Around 11, before it gets packed

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ok, but I'm not waiting in a queue for an hour

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We can book online, they have slots at 11 and 11:30

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Grab the 11, I'll be there. I need a strong coffee first

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Oat latte for you, right?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, plus some avocado toast if they've still got it

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: They had it last time, I think it's on the menu forever

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Excellent. See you there, don't be late like last month!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Cheeky. I was only twelve minutes late

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Could you water my plants while I'm in Spain next week? Be a star

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Of course! How often do they need it?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Tomatoes every day, the rest every few days. The cacti are fine

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Got it. Where's the key?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Under the blue plant pot by the door, or with Mrs Hughes next door

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Under the plant pot? Brave. Is that where the spare is?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ha, yes. The neighbour knows the spot too, so don't panic

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ok, I'll check the weather. If it's sunny, I'll go early in the morning

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, the tomatoes hate the midday sun

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Noted. Send me a photo of the beach so I feel jealous

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Deal! I'll send one of the tomatoes too, to prove they're still alive

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Haha, perfect. Enjoy the sun!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We need to pick a book for next month's club. Any ideas?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: What about the new crime novel everyone's talking about?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Already read it, the twist was obvious from page 50

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ouch. How about a shorter one then? Under 300 pages

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, that's a better plan. Nobody wants a huge book in winter

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Good point. Anything from last year's list that we skipped?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The one about the sea captain, I still have it

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oh I loved that. Maybe too similar though, the last pick was also a sea story

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: True. Let's vote in the group chat. Three options, one winner

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sounds fair. I'll send my shortlist tonight

turns.speaker: A
